differences.justification: AbstractElasticsearchEmbeddingStore.fullTextSearchMatches() returns EmbeddingMatch, the same core type already returned by search() and hybridSearch() via EmbeddingSearchResult

Elasticsearch SDK enum intentionally exposed by Builder.refresh(Refresh) on ElasticsearchEmbeddingStore and ElasticsearchContentRetriever, and by the protected initialize() overloads. The integration already exposes Elasticsearch SDK types (e.g. ElasticsearchClient) in its public API; this matches langchain4j-milvus-v2 exposing io.milvus.v2.common.ConsistencyLevel for the same purpose. All existing constructor signatures and the default Refresh.False behaviour are preserved.
